# clipmimic

> clipmimic is an MIT-licensed Claude Code skill and plugin. It studies a TikTok, Instagram Reel, YouTube Short or local video (shots, hook, pacing, captions, call to action), saves that as a Style Blueprint JSON file, and writes new per-shot prompts for your own topic. Generating clips through Replicate is optional and paid.

What works in v0.1: scene cuts, shot lengths, pacing and aspect via ffmpeg; title, hashtags, engagement and captions for URLs via yt-dlp; browser observation with the Claude in Chrome extension; platform presets for TikTok, Reels and Shorts; Replicate submit, status and model listing. Not built yet: transcription for videos without captions, automatic shot descriptions without Claude, assembling clips into a finished edit, providers other than Replicate.

clipmimic copies structure and style, not footage. It grants no rights to a reference's footage, script, music or people.

## Install

- `/plugin marketplace add splashxmoon/clipmimic`, then `/plugin install clipmimic@clipmimic`. Commands appear as `/clipmimic:analyze`, `/clipmimic:mimic` and so on.
- Requires Node.js 18+ and ffmpeg (with ffprobe); URL references also need yt-dlp.
